title: Coast Guard rescues 2 hikers, dog from Deschutes National Forrest, Oregon
credit: U.S. Coast Guard photo courtesy of Air Station Astoria
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter aircrew rescues 2 hikers and a dog after one of the hikers reportedly sustained a knee injury in Deschutes National Forrest, Oregon, June 16, 2024. The survivors were transported Redmond Municipal Airport to awaiting emergency medical services in stable condition. (U.S. Coast Guard photo courtesy of Air Station Astoria)
